ABOUT US

ABOUT US

THE HOPE RISING STORY

Welcome to HopeRising for Imolites! We are a dedicated non-governmental organization committed to empowering the youth of Imo State, Nigeria, through innovative training programs, advocacy for good governance, and grassroots community support. Our mission is to create sustainable livelihoods, foster economic independence, and improve the overall well-being of our communities.

Our Story
HopeRising for Imolites was founded in 2003 by Barr. Obioma Success Akagburuonye. Originating from Mbaise in Imo State, Barr. Akagburuonye has always harbored a deep passion for uplifting his community. Starting from humble beginnings, he has been driven by a vision to utilize God’s blessings to bless others. This vision materialized into various empowerment programs and initiatives that have positively impacted thousands of lives.

  • Our Mission

    Our mission is to:

    • Empower Youth: Through comprehensive training in skills such as solar energy installation, computer applications, and entrepreneurship, we aim to equip the youth with the tools needed for sustainable livelihoods.
    • Advocate for Good Governance: We believe in the power of good governance to transform societies. Our advocacy efforts focus on promoting transparency, accountability, and effective governance at all levels.
    • Provide Community Support: We are dedicated to supporting communities through healthcare initiatives, educational programs, and social welfare projects that address immediate needs and foster long-term development.

     

    Our Programs

    • Skills Training: We offer training programs in solar energy, CCTV installation, computer applications, and more, providing youth with the skills necessary for the modern job market.
    • Healthcare Initiatives: Our medical outreach programs provide essential healthcare services, including consultations, minor surgeries, and distribution of palliatives to those in need.
    • Advocacy and Awareness: We run campaigns and initiatives aimed at educating the public about good governance, civic responsibilities, and community involvement.
    • Volunteer and Partnership Opportunities: We invite individuals and organizations to join us in our mission. Through volunteering, partnerships, and mobilization efforts, we can amplify our impact and reach more people.

OUR FOUNDER

Barr. Obioma Success Akagburuonye is a passionate advocate for community development and youth empowerment. His journey from a challenging upbringing in Mbaise to becoming a beacon of hope for many is a testament to his resilience and dedication. Under his leadership, HopeRising for Imolites continues to grow and make significant strides in improving lives across Imo State.

ADVOCATE FOR CHANGE

We believe that everyone has a role to play in building a better future. Whether through volunteering, donating, or mobilizing your community, your support can make a substantial difference. Join us in our mission to empower, advocate, and support

OUR TEAM
